title: Function-by-function guide
text: Create one client per Skosmos REST API. Change API base URL use different provider.
code: finto <- skosmos_client("https://api.finto.fi/rest/v1/") ilc <- skosmos_client(   "https://vocabs.ilc4clarin.ilc.cnr.it/skosmos/rest/v1/" )

title: Function-by-function guide
text: Check whether endpoint responds vocabulary-list request.
code: skosmos_ping(finto)

title: Function-by-function guide
text: Use low-level API need original JSON route wrapped high-level helper.
code: raw <- skosmos_request(   finto,   "vocabularies",   query = list(lang = "en") ) str(raw)

title: Function-by-function guide
text: List vocabularies. id column especially important value used vocid vocabulary-specific functions.
code: vocabs <- skosmos_vocabularies(finto, lang = "en") vocabs vocabs$id

title: Function-by-function guide
text: Retrieve metadata one vocabulary.
code: skosmos_vocabulary(finto, vocid = "yso", lang = "en")  # Generic pattern: select one ID from discovery results. vocid <- vocabs$id[1] skosmos_vocabulary(finto, vocid, lang = "en")

title: Function-by-function guide
text: List available resource types globally one vocabulary.
code: skosmos_types(finto, lang = "en") skosmos_types(finto, lang = "en", vocid = "yso")

title: Function-by-function guide
text: List concept groups collections vocabulary. empty tibble valid vocabulary define groups.
code: groups <- skosmos_groups(finto, vocid = "yso", lang = "en") groups

title: Function-by-function guide
text: Return concepts top vocabulary hierarchy.
code: skosmos_top_concepts(finto, vocid = "yso", lang = "en")

title: Function-by-function guide
text: Search across vocabularies restrict search using vocabs.
code: skosmos_search(   finto,   query = "forest",   vocabs = "yso",   lang = "en",   maxhits = 10 )

title: Function-by-function guide
text: Search within exactly one vocabulary.
code: skosmos_vocabulary_search(   finto,   vocid = "yso",   query = "forest",   lang = "en",   maxhits = 10 )

title: Function-by-function guide
text: Resolve label concept one vocabulary.
code: skosmos_lookup(finto, vocid = "yso", label = "cat", lang = "en")

title: Function-by-function guide
text: Get label directly URI without first specifying vocabulary.
code: skosmos_label_uri(   finto,   uri = "http://www.yso.fi/onto/yso/p7160",   lang = "en" )

title: Function-by-function guide
text: First request valid index letters, browse one letter.
code: letters <- skosmos_index_letters(finto, "yso", lang = "en") letters skosmos_index(finto, "yso", letter = "A", lang = "en")

title: Function-by-function guide
code: skosmos_vocabulary_statistics(finto, "yso", lang = "en")

title: Function-by-function guide
code: skosmos_label_statistics(finto, "yso", lang = "en")

title: Function-by-function guide
text: routes depend server vocabulary support.
code: skosmos_new_concepts(finto, "yso", lang = "en", limit = 20) skosmos_modified_concepts(finto, "yso", lang = "en", limit = 20)

title: Function-by-function guide
text: Create concept handle reuse relationship calls.
code: cosmology <- skosmos_concept(   finto,   vocid = "yso",   uri = "http://www.yso.fi/onto/yso/p7160" ) cosmology

title: Function-by-function guide
code: skosmos_label(cosmology, lang = "en")

title: Function-by-function guide
text: Direct broader concepts versus ancestors.
code: skosmos_broader(cosmology, lang = "en") skosmos_broader_transitive(cosmology, lang = "en", limit = 20)

title: Function-by-function guide
text: Direct narrower concepts versus descendants.
code: skosmos_narrower(cosmology, lang = "en") skosmos_narrower_transitive(cosmology, lang = "en", limit = 20)

title: Function-by-function guide
code: skosmos_related(cosmology, lang = "en")

title: Function-by-function guide
code: skosmos_children(cosmology, lang = "en")

title: Function-by-function guide
text: Hierarchy responses can nested, nested branches preserved tibble list-columns.
code: skosmos_hierarchy(cosmology, lang = "en")

title: Function-by-function guide
code: skosmos_mappings(cosmology, lang = "en")

title: Function-by-function guide
text: Use real group URI returned skosmos_groups().
code: groups <- skosmos_groups(finto, "yso", lang = "en")  # Check the returned columns, then select a real group URI. group_uri <- groups$uri[1] group <- skosmos_concept(finto, "yso", group_uri) skosmos_group_members(group, lang = "en")

title: Function-by-function guide
text: Retrieve RDF concept/resource vocabulary.
code: ttl <- skosmos_data(   finto,   uri = "http://www.yso.fi/onto/yso/p7160",   vocid = "yso",   format = "text/turtle" )

title: Function-by-function guide
code: yso_ttl <- skosmos_vocabulary_data(   finto,   vocid = "yso",   format = "text/turtle" )

title: Function-by-function guide
code: skosmos_concept_data(cosmology, format = "application/ld+json")

what: Create a Skosmos REST API client — skosmos_client
title: Create a Skosmos REST API client — skosmos_client
text: Creates reusable client object pointing one Skosmos REST API v1 installation. high-level functions take object first argument. single package installation can therefore work Finto, UNESCO, AGROVOC, NFFA, CLARIN, compatible Skosmos server simply changing api_base.

text: client skosmos_client created skosmos_client(). query Search expression. Skosmos deployments commonly support wildcard characters *; exact search syntax server-dependent. lang Optional language search query. labellang Optional preferred language labels returned hits. vocabs Optional character vector vocabulary IDs. Multiple values sent space-separated Skosmos vocab parameter. type Optional concept/resource type filter. parent Optional parent concept URI used limit results. group Optional concept-group URI used limit results. maxhits Maximum number hits requested server. offset Number hits skip, useful pagination. fields Optional character vector fields requested Skosmos. unique Logical; request unique search results supported.

title: SkosmosR 0.1.0
text: General Skosmos REST v1 client. High-level JSON endpoints now return tibbles consistently; nested structures preserved list-columns. Added explicit vocabulary- concept-RDF helpers retaining low-level skosmos_request() escape hatch. Expanded validation scalar vocabulary IDs URIs clearer errors.
